plain: A former government scientist named John Blitch, who says he was taken by an alien, told podcast host Jesse Michels his idea about a craft said to have crashed near a place called Cape Girardeau before the Second World War. He suggests that if something fast was interfered with, perhaps by radar, near Wright-Patterson, an Air Force base in Ohio, it could have come down right there. He draws on the work of UFO writers Philip J. Corso, Stanton Friedman and Don Schmitt.
